scope: OwnerFs fixed-package continuous SDK I/O/lifecycle; 1h warmup plus full1h measurement; no faults/performance SLA
error_policy: fail on first error; no retries, replacements, omitted samples, intentional restart or weakened thresholds
cleanup_policy: SDK worker terminal, explicit Environment deletion, empty backend, normal AFS unmount/process exit, then Docker cleanup; all required

measurement.runtime_backing_bytes: st_blocks*512 on the owning filesystem; exclude submounts including erofs/overlay/tmpfs/bind views; hardlink inode counted once; include writable backing upperdirs and retained runtime streams
measurement.runtime_disk_bytes: Legacy cross-mount apparent size, retained as diagnostic only and not used as a disk-allocation bound
measurement.payload_delivery: Fixed 16KiB SDK file staging, readable by UID10000; short UID10000 command copies and fsyncs target. Payload never stored in command argv. Original confirmed-content check unchanged.
measurement.command_retention: Default3600s/4096 records; request dedup1800s/65536 unchanged. No Execd TTL/capacity override.
measurement.fds: Raw sum of all persistent process descriptors plus live anchor; peak_growth.fds and trends.fds apply to recomputed noncache FDs. Separate mode-specific raw caps also apply; warmup only excludes trend windows.
measurement.warmup: Fixed3600s of same active workload; no restart/cache flush/redeployment; no adaptive extension. All24 five-minute windows require work; trends use exactly12 measurement windows.

fd_accounting.cache_credit: One FD per unique live regular dev/inode directly in the explicitly owned DFS chunk root; deleted, duplicate and foreign handles receive no credit. Never credit OwnerFs, Meta, platform or anchor processes.
fd_accounting.raw_peak_growth: Node and each persistent process: 128 plus at most 256 only for each owned DFS afs-node; every raw descriptor is retained in evidence.
fd_accounting.steady_policy: Excess beyond capacity remains charged as noncache, including inflight readers. Every steady five-minute window must have median excess zero. Node AND individual process noncache trends are gated; raw trends remain diagnostic.
fd_accounting.binding: Raw census bound to PID/start_ticks and stable canonical chunk root path/device/inode; aggregate values independently recomputed. Missing, replaced or inconsistent evidence fails.

observation.peak_reference: first sample, including all warmup; never reset at measurement start
observation.raw_census: all PIDs visible in each owned container PID namespace; transient races retained, persistent roles must remain stable
